welcome.title: Shall we get started?
welcome.description: Tell us a little about your project. We’ll organize the essential information to understand your needs and prepare a tailored proposal.

service.title: Which service do you need? *
service.otherLabel: Which service are you looking for? *

need.title: What are your goals and what do you need to build?
need.label: Describe your needs *
need.placeholder: Describe your project, its context and main requirements…

details.title: Timeline and budget
details.hint: These details are optional and help provide context for your request.
details.budgetHint: Indicative ranges for context, without any price or timeline commitment.

contact.title: How can we contact you?
contact.hint: Enter your name and email so we can respond to your request.
contact.name: Full name *

review.title: Review your request
review.hint: Check your details. You can edit any step before finishing your review.

errors.needShort: Describe your needs using at least {min} characters.
errors.nameInvalid: Enter your full name, with at least two letters.
errors.nameLong: Use no more than {nameMax} characters for your name.
errors.emailInvalid: Enter a valid email address, such as name@example.com.
errors.otherServiceShort: Describe the service using at least {otherMin} characters.
errors.otherServiceLong: Use no more than {otherMax} characters for the service.

discard.title: Discard your answers?
discard.description: Your entered details will be deleted. This cannot be undone.

sending.title: Sending request…
sending.description: Wait for confirmation that your request was sent.

success.title: Request received
success.description: Receipt of your request has been confirmed.

error.title: Could not send request
error.description: Your details have been preserved. Check your connection and try again.

errors.rejected: The service did not accept your request. Your details have been preserved. Return to the review to check the fields or try again.
errors.rate-limit: The service has reached a submission limit. Your details have been preserved. Wait before trying again.
errors.unconfirmed: We could not confirm delivery. Your details have been preserved. The request may have been received; check before resending to avoid duplicates.
errors.spam: Your request could not be validated. Return to the review and check your details before trying again.
errors.invalid: Some fields are invalid. Return to the review and check your details before sending.

privacy.notice: We'll use your name, email address and project details to review your request and reply by email.
